angel noun

also guardian angel

late Latin

Vulg. Ps. 90 (91), 11
Tert.; Aug. (Lewis & Short)
M-O s.v. angel

angelus, angelī m.

noun, second declension

Greek ἄγγελος, a messenger. A guardian angel: Comenius says God gives each person angels from birth ut custōdēs (Orbis pictus 149).

Examples

  • Quoniam angelīs suīs mandāvit dē tē, ut custōdiant tē in omnibus viīs tuīs.

    For he has given his angels charge of you, to keep you in all your ways.Vulg. Ps. 90 (91), 11

See also saint.

SourcesLewis & Short: angelus
